## Course Logistics

**Lecturer:** Xabier Olaz Moratinos

**Email:** xabier.olaz@unavarra.es

**Office:** 9001 (Basement, 'Las Encinas' building)

**Office Hours:**
- Monday: 08:30-10:00
- Thursday: 14:00-15:30

> By default, unless stated otherwise, all office hours will be held in my office, although it will be useful if we agree on a time slot. You can contact me via the internal mail of MiAulario or at xabier.olaz@unavarra.es. This way we coordinate meetings and avoid overcrowding in the department hallway.

## Schedule

### Ciencia de Datos (Data Science)
- **Theory:** Monday 10:00-12:00 (Room A-119)
- **Lab:** Thursday 12:00-14:00 (Room A-306)
  - *Note:* On Feb 19th, lab will be in **Room A-304**.

### Biotecnología (Biotechnology)
- **Theory:** Monday 12:00-14:00 (Room A-222)
- **Lab:** Thursday 10:00-12:00 (Rooms A-311 & A-305 - Both groups)

### Lab Groups (Course 506108)
The course is split into 2 groups of 32 students for lab sessions:
- **Group 1:** Haizea Aguirre - Adrian Hernandez
- **Group 2:** Aitana Hualde - Martina Villanueva

## Evaluation Criteria (10 points total)

### Exam (5 points)
- **Mandatory:** It is mandatory to pass the exam in order to pass the course.
- **Environment:** Practical exam performed on a computer using **Linux**. **NO Internet access** allowed.
- **Retake:** If you fail the ordinary call, the retake exam is worth **100% of the final grade**. The grade obtained in this exam will be your final grade for the course.

**Dates:**
- **Final Exam:** May 25, 2026 (16:00)
- **Retake Exam:** June 17, 2026 (16:00)

### Deliverables (5 points)

**1. Major Projects (4 points)**
These projects are critical and **must be done individually**. They include code correction and personalized feedback.

| Project | Points |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Linked Lists** | 2 |
| **Huffman Coding** | 2 |

**2. Weekly Exercises (1 point)**
These are standard delivery items. Each exercise is worth **0.125 points** (Max 1 point total).

| Lab Project | Delivery/Correction | Points |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sparse Matrices** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Working with Files** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Postfix Calculator** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Palindromes** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Balanced Parentheses** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Conway's Game of Life** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Recursion Exercises** | Delivery | 0.125 |
| **Constructing Binary Trees** | Delivery | 0.125 |

## Criterios de Evaluación

| Método de evaluación | Peso (%) | Política de recuperación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |

**Fechas de Exámenes:**
* **25/05/2026: 16:00** → Examen final: Todo

## Detalles de Evaluación

### ■ Examen (5 puntos):
* **Obligatorio:** Es obligatorio aprobar el examen para aprobar el curso.
* **Entorno:** El examen práctico se realizará en ordenador con **Linux** y **SIN acceso a Internet**.
* **Recuperación:** Si suspendes la convocatoria ordinaria, el examen de recuperación vale el **100% de la nota**. La nota que obtengas en dicho examen será la nota final que vaya a actas.

### ■ Entregables (5 puntos):
* Todos los entregables serán revisados para confirmar la entrega correcta.

**1. Proyectos Principales (4 puntos):**
Estos proyectos **son individuales** y se corregirán detalladamente.
